text:
Honestly blown away by how well-crafted this UI resource is. 😲

It's a massive library of 2,000+ hand-drawn illustrations spanning dozens of categories, and they all look incredibly clean.

You can download them directly as vector assets or use them seamlessly via their Figma plugin.

Also... the sound effects on their site are a surprisingly fun touch. 😂

Just an insanely useful tool for developers, designers, and builders shipping products.

Link: kitbitz.art
